name: Fitness Business Marketing Framework
description: Comprehensive templates for gyms, personal trainers, fitness studios, and wellness businesses

pain_points: Previous failed attempts at fitness routines
Intimidation by gym environments and equipment
Plateau in fitness progress and results
Cost concerns and membership commitment anxiety

value_propositions.template: Achieve your [fitness goal] in [timeframe] with our proven [program type] that's helped [number] people transform their bodies
Join a supportive fitness community where everyone celebrates your progress and keeps you motivated
Flexible [workout type] that fits your busy schedule - train anytime, anywhere with expert guidance
Start your fitness journey with confidence - beginner-friendly programs designed for real people, not just athletes

personal_training.template: Get personalized workouts, proper form coaching, and accountability from certified trainers who adapt every session to your goals, fitness level, and schedule.

group_fitness_classes.template: Experience the energy and motivation of group workouts with expert instruction, varied routines, and a supportive community that makes fitness fun.

nutrition_coaching.template: Transform your relationship with food through sustainable nutrition coaching that teaches you how to fuel your body for energy, performance, and long-term health.

strength_training.template: Build lean muscle, increase metabolism, and gain functional strength with progressive strength training programs designed for all fitness levels.

weight_loss_programs.template: Lose weight and keep it off with our comprehensive approach combining effective workouts, nutrition guidance, and lifestyle coaching for lasting results.

onboarding_sequence.template: Welcome to [Gym Name], [Member Name]! Your fitness journey starts now. Here's what to expect in your first week and how to get the most from your membership.
How was your first week, [Member Name]? Our team is here to help you feel comfortable and confident. Book your complimentary fitness assessment to create your personalized plan.
30 days in, [Member Name]! You're building great habits. Ready to take it to the next level? Let's discuss your progress and set new goals.

motivation_messages.template: We miss you at [Gym Name], [Member Name]! Life gets busy, but your health is worth 30 minutes today. What can we do to help you get back on track?
Congratulations, [Member Name]! You've achieved [milestone]. Your dedication is paying off - keep up the amazing work!
